explanation: The first sub-word fragment of a multi-token verb, usually Latinate, before its suffix is completed: preced|e, outper|forms, disqual|ify, incentiv|izing, persu|ading, perme|ated, encaps|ulates, encompass|es. Weaker firings on similar split stems (adm|iring, herald|ed, re-e|valuate, \per|p).
